name: usage
description: How it is called, such as assure ledger --commit <sha>.

name: description
description: Its flags and its output in brief.

name: file
description: The file, from the product root.

name: description
description: What in the file implements which contracts, by name.

name: statement
description: The promise, in one sentence with MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD or MAY.

name: group_name
description: A short heading it is shown under among its siblings.

name: file
description: The test file, from the product root, once it exists; it names the test ID in a test or subtest name. Empty while the test is still the emitted code's test, named in notes.

name: when
description: What the test does.

name: then
description: What the test expects.

name: notes
description: Anything a reader needs, such as which test function still needs the ID.

name: file
description: The file, from the product root; it may not exist yet.

name: description
description: What in the file keeps which contracts, by name.

name: statement
description: The contract, stated with MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD or MAY, in one sentence.

name: introduced_in
description: The component version that introduced the contract.

name: spec_doc
description: The document in specs/ that recorded the contract before it became data.

name: group_name
description: A short heading the contract is shown under among its siblings, such as Transport or Audit.

name: file
description: The test file, from the product root. It names the test ID at the start of a test name.

name: given
description: The state the test starts from.

name: when
description: What the test does.

name: then
description: What the test expects.

name: notes
description: Anything a reader needs, such as a gate the test needs to run.

name: name
description: The component's name in the registry, such as postgres-adapter.

name: version
description: The version the component declares, such as 4.13.0.

name: stage
description: The component's maturity: alpha, beta or ga.

name: sunset
description: The date an alpha or beta component stops working. A ga component has none.

name: declaration_path
description: The folder that holds the component's declaration, from the product root.

name: generator_package
description: The Go package that implements the component's generator, from the product root.

name: retired_id
description: The ID of the obligation the change removes, which the base branch's head still has.

name: reason
description: Why the obligation leaves the specification, in a sentence.

name: retired_on
description: The date the Product owner decided the retirement.

name: import_path
description: The package's Go import path inside the runtime module.

name: concern
description: What the package holds, in a sentence.
